items.title: Review public AI and development service ports
items.zsec_action: Run zsec check. Public AI/dev listeners should usually bind to 127.0.0.1 and sit behind nginx/Apache/auth, unless intentionally public.

items.summary: SSH brute-force and botnet activity is a constant Linux server risk.
items.title: Keep SSH brute-force protection active
items.zsec_action: Keep fail2ban active, keep SSH keys backed up, and keep the admin IP allowlist current.
